lines.text: Arise! Oh Righteous Sun, arise!
On Mount Zion shinning gently
Cast darkness away from our sight
Awaken all our souls to life.
Thine grace, release on us we plead
Like of the dew and of the rain
Reveal to us, rewarding grace
Thine salvation all we may claim.
Amen.
